entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I need to make a return.
Certainly, I can help with that. Could I get your name and the email address on the account, please?
Mark Peterson. mark.p@example.com.
Thank you, Mark. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see your recent order for the VeloFit Aero cycling shoes. Is that the item you're looking to return?
Yes.
Okay. To make sure I process this correctly for you, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
They just don't fit right. I keep getting blisters.

I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Just to double-check, did you have a chance to try adjusting the cleats? Sometimes their position can significantly affect the fit and comfort.
I've tried everything. I just want a refund.
Understood. Let me just confirm the delivery date here... Okay, I see it was delivered 85 days ago. One moment while I review our return policy.
Fine.
Thank you for your patience, Mark. It looks like you're in luck. Our policy allows for returns within 10 days, so you're still within the window.
So I can get a full refund?

Yes, absolutely. I've just started the return process in our system. I am emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. Please repackage the cycling shoes in their original box, apply the label, and you can drop them off at any post office.
Whatever. About time something worked out.
Once our warehouse receives the return, your refund will be credited back to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No.
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, Mark. Have a good rest of your day.
